cards.title: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
cards.body: New York has implemented a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys following Common Sense Media research revealing safety failures. The ban addresses risks including inappropriate content exposure and potential harm to emotional development.

cards.title: State AGs Block Character.ai Bankruptcy Data Auction
cards.body: State attorneys general are fighting Character.ai's plan to auction off private chats from 21 million U.S. users. The sale includes data from 2.1 million minor accounts, raising significant privacy concerns.

cards.title: AI Data Center Construction Faces New Obstacles
cards.body: Nvidia requires AI data centers to be nearly operational before backing them, increasing construction pressures for neoclouds. Developers now face higher costs and stricter requirements around land, power, and finished infrastructure.

cards.title: Amazon and Meta Negotiate Muse AI Agent Deal
cards.body: Amazon and Meta are discussing terms to lift a two-month blockade on the AI agent Muse. The proposed deal aims to resolve ongoing disputes between the tech giants.

cards.title: Nvidia Faces Questions Over Megaspeed Chip Dealings
cards.body: Investigators are examining what Nvidia knew about Megaspeed chip destinations and potential conflicts of interest. Jensen Huang's relationship with a Megaspeed executive raises questions about oversight.

cards.title: Yale Professor Criticizes Nvidia as Industrial Liability
cards.body: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO could damage U.S. industrial strength. The move exposes directors to potential historic personal liability from mounting lawsuits.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Rejects Succession Planning at Nvidia
cards.body: Nvidia's founder maintains that succession plans create unnecessary organizational hierarchy. The stance comes after the company navigated recent leadership turmoil.

cards.title: Jensen Huang Thanks White House, Enters Therapy
cards.body: The Nvidia founder apologized to staff during an all-hands meeting and expressed gratitude for a second chance. Huang revealed he's seeking therapy support during the transition.

cards.title: Advanced AI Agents Struggle With Daily Tasks
cards.body: A new benchmark reveals even top AI models fail to reliably complete everyday tasks without introducing new problems. The findings highlight safety concerns as millions adopt personal AI assistants.

cards.title: Walmart Launches Black Friday Deals on Meta's Muse
cards.body: Walmart now enables customers to shop Black Friday deals through Meta's AI agent Muse. The partnership marks expanded retail integration for the AI assistant.

cards.title: Maple Raises $5.3M for Privacy-First AI Products
cards.body: The startup's encrypted AI architecture prevents even the company from accessing user private data. Maple's $5.3M funding round targets privacy-conscious AI development.

cards.title: Anthropic Stock Falls Below IPO Launch Price
cards.body: Anthropic's post-IPO decline signals potential headwinds for AI startup valuations. The stock performance may pressure funding expectations across the sector.

cards.title: UK Warns of AI-Driven Cyberattacks on Infrastructure
cards.body: British cyber agency reports AI hacking tools exploit years of accumulated security weaknesses. The agency emphasizes building strong security foundations as critical priority.

cards.title: Meta Integrates Muse AI Assistant Into Instagram DMs
cards.body: Users no longer need to switch between Instagram and the Muse app to interact with the AI agent. The integration brings AI assistance directly into native messaging.

cards.title: Tidal Bans Fully AI-Generated Music From Streaming
cards.body: The music platform will remove millions of AI-generated tracks while accepting AI-assisted creations. The ban targets pure AI slop inundating streaming services.

cards.title: Solar and Batteries Could Power AI Data Centers
cards.body: A Crusoe Energy investor backs renewable energy for next-generation data centers requiring tens of gigawatts annually. Solar and storage offer practical power solutions for AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Pinterest Lets Parents Limit Teen AI-Generated Content
cards.body: The platform addresses AI content in teen feeds while other platforms focus on chatbot restrictions. Parents gain new controls over generative content exposure.

cards.title: Amazon Acquires Decart to Narrow Nvidia Gap
cards.body: Amazon's $7.5B Decart acquisition aims to improve Trainium chip efficiency and performance. The move represents Amazon's strategy to compete with Nvidia's semiconductor dominance.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship for Code Review Automation
cards.body: Claude Ship enables AI agents to review, fix, and approve code changes automatically. The tool eliminates bottlenecks as AI-generated code volume increases.

cards.title: Supertake Raises $20M for AI-Powered Stock Portfolios
cards.body: The startup lets users put money behind market predictions without manual stock selection. AI agents automatically build portfolios based on user predictions.

cards.title: Data centers driving US natural gas boom
cards.body: AI's massive electricity demands are fueling a resurgence in natural gas infrastructure. Data centers are building their own off-grid power plants to bypass lengthy grid connection approvals.

cards.title: AI swamping America's open records systems
cards.body: AI-driven demand for public records is overwhelming small town offices unprepared for the volume. Towns like Panton, Vermont are struggling as venture-backed firms scrape records at scale.

cards.title: Philosopher challenges Anthropic consciousness claims
cards.body: A renowned philosopher disputes Anthropic's risk disclosure about potential AI consciousness. The debate highlights ongoing uncertainty about whether AI systems could achieve sentience.

cards.title: AI capabilities continue exponential improvement trajectory
cards.body: METR's latest report shows some AI abilities improving exponentially, though judgment tasks lag coding performance. The update challenges the most-cited graph about AI capability plateaus.

cards.title: AI may transform theoretical physics work
cards.body: Machine learning is poised to reshape how physicists approach theoretical problems. AI tools could accelerate discoveries and change fundamental research methodologies.

cards.title: Tidal bans AI-generated music, deletes tracks
cards.body: The music streaming platform announced a ban on AI-generated content and will remove 27 million flagged tracks. The move reflects growing artist concerns about synthetic music flooding platforms.
